cases.name: Sharon Benyo
cases.about:
She was the ex-wife of Beaver County defense attorney Gerald Benyo. She was released from state prison about three weeks earlier and was on track to get her life in order, Beaver County District Attorney David Lozier said during a news conference.

https://triblive.com/local/regional/police-arrest-suspect-in-death-of-woman-found-in-beaver-county-field/
cases.narrative: On 10/6/2021, her body was discovered by utility workers in an open field in the 2400 block of Constitution Boulevard, also known as Route 51, in Chippewa Township. Shot in head.
